collection: The Vegetable Guru: 30 photo-derived illustration choices
scope: Six accepted original masters plus 24 new candidates; no page installation or production approval.
numbering: 01–04 and 07–08 retained verbatim. 05/06 remain excluded following John’s feedback. New choices are 09–32.
source_mix: John’s Photos library, mounted photo/video archives and nine openly licensed online photographs. Native local video frames were used instead of compressed channel copies.
style: Direct approved richer-a heroes. Each new illustration starts from its source photo and approved style references, never from a repeated redraw of a page.
alpha_note: Transparent original PNG bytes retained. Some near-transparent edge pixels have alpha 1–2; the substantial silhouette is fully contained. Hidden RGB can show a halo in viewers that ignore alpha.
recreation: Original source photographs/stills, exact generation requests and style references are retained. Generative reruns are not deterministic; the supplied PNG masters are the exact reusable results.

assets.title: Pepper harvest
assets.prompt: Create one standalone botanical illustration for The Vegetable Guru inner pages, not a page layout. The FIRST reference is John's real photograph: use it for the actual vegetable shapes, their asymmetry, angles, overlap and natural composition. References 2 and 3 are the APPROVED BOOK HERO ART and must govern drawing style: bold simplified silhouettes, broad crisp colour and shadow planes, dimensional hand-shaped vector-like botanical drawing, rich natural crop colours, lime and forest greens, tapered cream highlight slashes and occasional rhythmic scalloped highlights, a few major veins only. No fine ink hatching, no watercolour, no pencil, no grain or mottled texture, no photographic skin gloss, no black outline. Ignore and DO NOT reproduce the reference heroes' green/black background haze. Truly transparent PNG background, no glow, no halo, no cast shadow or ground plane, no white backing, no lettering or border. Keep entire silhouette inside canvas with 7% clear padding. Large high resolution. Landscape 3:2 composition. Isolate a loose low harvest group from the photo: the two curved long dark-green chillies at the left and four uneven squat lobed peppers from the centre/right (one red, one orange, two green). Keep their observed irregular lobing, downward/sideways orientations, varied size and slight overlap; arrange as a relaxed shallow arc derived from their positions in the photograph, not a uniform row or decorative symmetry. All stalks should have natural endpoints. Omit the kitchen board, every background object and other peppers. Complete any edges clipped by the photo sparingly. No leaves invented for harvested fruits.
assets.intentional_changes: Six fruits selected from the photograph; varied lobes, colours and angles retained. Background and surplus fruit omitted.
assets.proposed_use: A colourful contents header or end-of-section illustration.
